items.english_summary: The UK Prime Minister outlined plans to devolve powers and funding to local communities in Scotland, promoting collaboration between UK and Scottish governments to foster inclusive economic growth, innovation, and reindustrialisation, addressing shared regional challenges through community-led renewal initiatives.
